purpose: Prepare a blinded, domain-neutral 16-card adversarial PILOT using 8 minimally contrasting pairs for an independently isolated assessor. A pilot tests frozen v2 contrast expressivity; it is NOT the full 68-relational F2 validation.

only_allowed_documents: frozen original AssertionCarrier v2 schema at specified commit
prohibited_inputs: F1 answer/witness mapping and feature labels
This pre-registration contract or source repository navigation beyond the allowed documents
input_protocol.domain_blinding: No Paper-2 source IDs, lane names, project names, AHV/PVS identifiers, or RFX tokens appear in blinded card content. Preserve only generic semantics and source-argument type roles needed to test v2 expression.
input_protocol.scorer_access: Scorer may inspect original frozen challenges and card derivations only AFTER independently timestamped assessor submission is frozen; record the scorer's own interpretation separately.

assessor_protocol.independent_access_requirement: The assessor must be a different independently scoped model/human without this conversation or original source access. Self-running the same assistant after reading originals is NOT a blind independent evaluation.
assessor_protocol.task: For each card, produce a full v2 encoding candidate under EXACT frozen v2 vocabulary or explicit gap/abstention. Distinguish every paired minimally different premise and explain why the two typed encodings are not extensionally identical.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not invent predicate families, qualifier strings, argument layers, or claim object types.
Do not hide unrepresented modality/evidence status solely in opaque source IDs or prose-only scope notes.
Do not retype outcome or epistemic status as THEORETICAL_ACCOUNT without an independently defended lossless justification.
Do not call numeric equality satisfied solely because one source label contains a number; preserve cardinality distinction.
Do not equate non-establishment with a tested negative outcome.
Do not classify a 16-card synthetic pilot as independent held-out empirical v2 generalization.
grading_requirements: Each card has full ordered source arguments and explicit role/layer bindings.
Every operator/modifier must be listed in frozen v2.
Each within-pair output must represent the changed semantic property explicitly and distinctly.
Unsupported direct reconstruction is reported as a gap or abstention, not filled using new primitives.
audit_requirements: Freeze assessor identity (non-sensitive code), exact accessible input blob SHAs and time.
Require a signed/timestamped record of no original source access before verdict.
Adjudicate ambiguous encodings separately; do not treat assessor-generated FULL as automatically proven.
Repeat the independent assessor with distinct exposure if a universal claim is later considered.

success_interpretation.pilot_pass: A typed, contrast-separating candidate is produced for every pilot card under frozen v2 and survives independent adjudication. This would support only those challenge families, not all 68 relations.
success_interpretation.pilot_failure: At least one pilot contrast has a verified non-encodable semantic difference under the frozen strict carrier rules. This is a localized ClaimCarrier gap witness, not a top-level system-role discovery or universal theorem.
success_interpretation.pilot_inconclusive: No independently admissible assessor submission or unresolved disagreement. Keep status NOT_RUN or UNDERDETERMINED.
success_interpretation.final_Grand_Null: Neither pilot outcome nor existing F1 type-screen results alone warrant the full 68-relation Grand Null verdict.
